result.summary: The page is mostly visually coherent, but a few elements look incomplete or awkwardly clipped, especially the empty top-right action button and content running underneath the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right appears empty except for a small red dot, making it look like an icon/avatar failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Add the intended icon, avatar, or notification graphic inside the circle, or remove the empty button if it is not needed.

issues.description: The bottom navigation overlays the content; the second restaurant card is cut off behind the fixed tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards and text are not hidden behind the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Several horizontal carousel items are visibly clipped at the right edge, including the category chip after “Healthy” and the third restaurant card in “Fastest near you.” This may be intentional, but it can look like the layout is cropped.
issues.suggestion: If these are scrollable carousels, ensure the clipping feels intentional with consistent spacing or a scroll affordance. Otherwise, adjust item widths/gaps so visible items fit cleanly within the viewport.
